name: chat
description: A panel or a launcher where visitors ask the site's AI

variants.panel: A section on the page: transcript, suggestions, input
variants.float: A corner button opening the panel (site or page)
variants.none: No chat on this page (page level)

greeting.description: First message, shown before anyone asks

valueDescriptions.anyone: Anyone, signed in or not; spends the model budget

limit.description: Messages per conversation before a new chat

show.description: Components an answer may hold besides text

valueDescriptions.pricing: The site's own pricing block, quoted as its page shows it
valueDescriptions.faq: Questions and answers the model writes
valueDescriptions.cta: One button to a destination this file declares
valueDescriptions.feature: A short list the model writes
valueDescriptions.chart: A bar, line, area or pie chart; figures from public tables, or labelled AI-generated
valueDescriptions.table: A table of public rows or figures, or labelled AI-generated
valueDescriptions.stats: Up to four key figures with their change
valueDescriptions.cards: Up to four cards; images only from this site's galleries or tables
valueDescriptions.dashboard: Stats, charts, tables and cards under one title
valueDescriptions.explore: A data set with sliders, dates, toggles or a form that recompute its tables, stats and charts in the page
valueDescriptions.map: A map of pins and routes from public table rows, or labelled AI-placed, with its places listed as text
valueDescriptions.auto: Presets the build makes from public tables and lists
valueDescriptions.all: Every component above and auto; pricing only with a public pricing block
valueDescriptions.sections: pricing faq cta feature; pricing only with a public pricing block

knows.description: Public tables whose rows ground the answers, up to 3

ask.description: A suggested question; use or show answers it without AI

answer.description: An answer written once; the model shows it by name

checks.message: only one chat per page — remove the second
title is longer than 60 characters — shorten it
greeting is longer than 200 characters — shorten it
suggested question '{label}' is longer than 80 characters — shorten it
{n} suggested questions, maximum is 4 — remove some
title is empty — write a heading, or remove the line for the default
greeting is empty — write the first message, or remove the line
a suggested question is empty — write it, or remove the line
this page already has the site's chat float — remove this one, or write chat none to leave it out here
